nieuw.titel: Include Skycutters for their points efficiency
nieuw.tekst: He considers the Lothern Skycutter an automatic inclusion in his High Elf list because of its points efficiency.
nieuw.waarom: He highlights a 90-point heavy chariot with flight and Swiftstride as an exceptionally good deal.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He finds its 60-by-100 base cumbersome in practice: it can obstruct line of sight, and getting a target into its charge arc can be difficult.

bronnen.citaat: is probably the most point efficient unit there is

extraCitaten.citaat: it's definitely the best deal and I think an automatic inclusion in the list

nieuw.titel: Charge bait need not face the charger
nieuw.tekst: When a large-based unit is baiting a charge and you intend to flee, it need not face the charger head-on. You can keep it perpendicular for other charge options, since fleeing will pivot it away from the attacker anyway.
nieuw.waarom: He says receiving the charge in the flank would not have mattered because he intended to flee; the fleeing pivot would still send the unit in the direction he wanted.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He offered a Lothern Skycutter as bait for the Duke, intending to flee and rally, but later realised he should have angled it rather than leaving it facing forwards.

bronnen.citaat: didn't need to be front on

extraCitaten.citaat: remember I was fleeing anyway it would have pivoted

bron.citaat: hooked it around and faced it perpendicular

extraCitaten.citaat: you want to face them perpendicular

aanvullingen.toelichting: Both recommend planning movement and wheels to finish perpendicular, maximising subsequent charge options.
